full_inspection: Inspected all four native images line by line, including both full displayed formulas, every underline, the n overwriting and marginal n, the area after ouvertes and the archive numerals. Paired enlargement confirms the exact n/m relationship. All handwritten marks and differing loci are recorded.
original_transcription_comparison: Compared both complete original transcriptions and the checked copy1 source. Copy2 adds the n overwriting and margin n; its note also mentions the preceding foliation point omitted in its original macro. Copy1 alone has the uncertain point after ouvertes. The originally commented copy2 margin macro is now active.

entries.decision: retain this copy2 spelling revision in apparatus; preserve copy1 in the base
entries.reason: The thick single-arch n is written over the original typed m; the matching margin n makes the new letter clear.

entries.decision: retain the handwritten margin n and make its source macro renderable
entries.reason: A large single-arch n is clear in the right margin. The original macro lay after a TeX comment sign and has been moved before it without changing the reading.

entries.decision: retain the copy1 point under uncertainty and the copy2 absence; do not assign a definite typed origin
entries.reason: A separated point lies at the copy1 line baseline after ouvertes; the matching copy2 area is blank. The copy1 point may be a speck, so its origin remains unresolved.

entries.decision: retain both archive numbers and the uncertain point before88 without author attribution
entries.reason: Both foliation numbers are clearly handwritten. Copy2 has a separate darker preceding point whose origin is unresolved; no matching point precedes copy1 number12.
